parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the listener. The description must be **1** to **80** characters in length.
> The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: EipTransmit
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable EIP pass-through. Valid values:

- **on**: Enabled.
- **off** (default): Disabled.

parameters.name: EstablishedTimeout
parameters.description: The connection timeout period. Valid values: **10** to **900**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: HealthCheckConnectPort
parameters.description: The port used for health checks. Valid values: **1** to **65535**. If this parameter is not set, the backend service port (BackendServerPort) is used.

parameters.name: HealthCheckConnectTimeout
parameters.description:
The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from a health check. If the backend ENS does not respond within the specified time, the health check fails.
- Default value: 5 seconds.
- Valid values: **1** to **300**.
- Unit: seconds.

> If the value of HealthCheckConnectTimeout is less than the value of HealthCheckInterval, HealthCheckConnectTimeout becomes invalid and the timeout period is set to the value of HealthCheckInterval.

parameters.name: HealthCheckDomain
parameters.description: The domain name used for health checks.

parameters.name: HealthCheckHttpCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status code for a Normal health check. Valid values:

- **http_2xx** (default).
- **http_3xx**.
- **http_4xx**.
- **http_5xx**.

parameters.name: HealthCheckInterval
parameters.description: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: HealthCheckType
parameters.description:
The health check type. Valid values:
- **tcp** (default).
- **http**.

parameters.name: HealthCheckURI
parameters.description:
The URI used for health checks. The URI must be **1** to **80** characters in length.
> The URI cannot be only `/` but must start with `/`.

parameters.name: HealthyThreshold
parameters.description: The number of consecutive successful health checks required before the health check status of a backend server changes from fail (unreachable) to success (reachable). Valid values: **2** to **10**.

parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description: The listener port whose attributes you want to modify. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing instance.

parameters.name: PersistenceTimeout
parameters.description:
The timeout period of session persistence.

- Default value: 0, which indicates that session persistence is disabled.
- Valid values: **0** to **3600**.
- Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Scheduler
parameters.description:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:
- **wrr**: Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests.
- **wlc**: Requests are distributed based on the weight and actual load (number of connections) of each backend server. When the weights are the same, backend servers with fewer connections receive more requests.
- **rr**: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.
- **sch**: Consistent hashing based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.
- **tch**: Consistent hashing based on four factors: source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port. Requests from the same flow are distributed to the same backend server.

parameters.name: UnhealthyThreshold
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks required before the health check status of a backend server changes from success (reachable) to fail (unreachable). Valid values: **2** to **10**.
